summary: Five Reels a day, every day, on one schedule. The day has five times (7 and 10 AM, 1, 4 and 7 PM Arizona). A post you approve takes the next open one of those times instead of one a day on your posting days, and at the times you haven't filled the specialist makes its own Reel, so it stays five a day.
frontend: Schedule shows today's remaining times and the next two days, five each: what you approved for a time, or which Reel the specialist makes there (news explainer, satisfying video, product ad).
Approve puts a post at the next open time (it goes out about 20 past the hour), often the same day, instead of the next Monday, Wednesday or Friday.
Settings no longer has posting days and a posting time; it says the five times instead.
other: The daily Reel run skips its slot when a post you approved has that time, and says so on the History, which also saves that Reel's cost.
Hitta's answers know the five times.
